policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 13 Apr close (1x4 3.86, 3x6 3.94, 6x9 4.03, 9x12 4.14 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 30bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 9 Apr; Glapiński sees no near-term change either way - hikes only in a 'black scenario' of renewed war, a question mark over cuts. March minutes (13 Apr): most members saw a much lower chance of further cuts; Janczyk: rates flat for the coming quarters. March flash CPI 3.0% (31 Mar; 3.3% expected); core 2.5% in February. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 30 Apr (13 Apr).
policy.risk_text: Two-sided: Hormuz headlines swing oil by up to 10% a day; the MPC holds at least until July (Kotecki), so the front end is anchored near WIBOR while 5-10Y follows Bunds and oil. Supply: April sales of PLN 15-39bn.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar); the NBP forecaster survey (1 Apr) has 2026 CPI at 2.9%. The next projection comes in July.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.2% of GDP (GUS preliminary, 1 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; S&P (2-6 Apr) sees a 2026 deficit of 7.0% of GDP (8.0% in an oil-shock case); budget deficit after February PLN 48.5bn; fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) to 30 Apr.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~41% (end-Q1) financed; USD 6bn of 5Y/10Y/30Y priced on 7 Apr (UST +65/+105/+130bp); budget accounts PLN 169.5bn at end-March. No rating action in April; S&P reviews Poland on 8 May (A-, stable); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar and held on 9 Apr; March CPI 3.0% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 13 Apr: MoF set the 15 Apr sale at PLN 6-12bn (OK0128, WS0428, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1035, NZ0936); the fuel VAT and excise cuts were extended to 30 Apr; March MPC minutes: most members saw a much lower chance of further cuts; Janczyk: rates flat for the coming quarters; February current account -EUR 0.99bn (+0.43bn expected); Millennium: about one 2026 hike priced. Abroad: the US blockade began and Brent jumped back to ~$102; nearly three ECB and two BoE hikes priced; Bund 10Y 3.09%, UST 10Y 4.33%; Tisza won a two-thirds majority in Hungary - the forint rallied and the HU10Y fell to ~6.3%.

calendar.plan_text: MoF April plan (31 Mar): sale auctions on 15 Apr (PLN 4-12bn; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1035, NZ0936), 23 Apr (6-14bn) and 28 Apr (5-13bn; new 10Y DS0436 replaces DS1035 from 23 Apr); no switch; a 50-week T-bill on 10 Apr (3-6bn). Q2 plan: 7-8 sales for PLN 50-90bn and 1-2 switches. 2026 needs ~41% financed at end-Q1. 7 Apr: USD 6bn issue (5Y 4.645%, 10Y 5.405%, 30Y 6.233%). 10 Apr T-bill: PLN 3.0bn at 3.95% (demand 3.6bn) plus 0.39bn. 15 Apr offer (13 Apr): PLN 6-12bn, WS0428 added.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it. April is back to regular supply: remaining sales 15 Apr, 23 Apr, 28 Apr. Next MPC 5-6 May: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker.

facts.core_text: Regime: fragile truce with a US blockade of Iranian ports - oil swinging between $90 and $105; the NBP held at 3.75% on 9 Apr while FRAs price roughly 30bp of NBP hikes; the ECB and BoE are priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste published no table for the 13 Apr close, so CDS and the 10Y spread are not quoted.) Blockade; Tisza two-thirds win in Hungary (13 Apr).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK's Q2 FPC calendar (31 Mar) has tenders on 16 and 29 Apr, 14 and 28 May and 18 Jun; on 26 Mar it sold only PLN 0.87bn (demand 1.06bn) plus 0.20bn.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
